items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal to fell the lime trees
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Behörde: Landkreis Musterpeene, Kreishausweg 1, 17109 Musterdemmin.
items.computation: Letter dated and presumably posted 19.11.2026 (no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date given, so letter date is used as posting day). Delivery fiction for authority letters posted on/after 1 Jan 2025: deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting (§41 Abs.2 VwVfG M-V) = 19.11.2026 + 4 days = 23.11.2026 (a Monday, not a Saturday/Sunday/holiday, and as a general authority — not a tax office — the delivery day would not move even if it fell on one). Bekanntgabe = 23.11.2026. One-month Widerspruch period under §70 VwGO/§31 VwVfG counted per §188 Abs.2 BGB: period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the day of Bekanntgabe, i.e. 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in MV, so no shift under §31 Abs.3 VwVfG is needed.
